tree-sitter WASM for Damn-Bot codeintel — provenance and licenses
====================================================================

Embedded asset: internal/codeintel/ts/ts.wasm
Source: https://github.com/malivvan/tree-sitter
Commit: 5aa45b3d087ac4f9014faa31e2ea7a5eeabe834b (tag v0.0.1)
License: MIT (malivvan), containing:
  - tree-sitter runtime, MIT, Copyright (c) 2018-2024 Max Brunsfeld
    (api.h/lib.c byte-identical to upstream tree-sitter v0.24.x; parser
    sources adapted for the WASM build by the malivvan project)
  - tree-sitter-c v0.23.4 @ 3efee11f784605d44623d7dadd6cd12a0f73ea92
  - tree-sitter-cpp v0.23.4 @ f41e1a044c8a84ea9fa8577fdd2eab92ec96de02
  - tree-sitter-javascript v0.23.1 @ 3a837b6f3658ca3618f2022f8707e29739c91364
  - tree-sitter-python v0.23.6 @ bffb65a8cfe4e46290331dfef0dbf0ef3679de11
  - tree-sitter-typescript v0.23.2 @ f975a621f4e7f532fe322e13c4f79495e0a7b2e7
    (grammar typescript + tsx)

The asset is built from the pinned source tarball with the pinned Zig
toolchain by scripts/build-codeintel-wasm.sh; see
internal/codeintel/ts/ORIGIN.md for the SHA-256 and docs/ATTRIBUTION.md for the
attribution row.
